criterion: 250 logical PPO agents, synchronous population generations, 1024 PPO training decisions per agent per generation. Same rotating two-day development probe for every agent in a generation. Only age>=5 can be replaced; preserve top10%, replace bottom20% (including5% fresh immigrants). Inherit whole compatible weights and mutate learning_rate, ent_coef, gamma, clip_range. Every50generations evaluate current leaders on full fixed development quarter and archive the anchor winner. After generation1000 evaluate up to10 development finalists on validation; freeze winner/modelSHA before a single final-test evaluation. Never select by final test.
